name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct for EXCAVA. It’s the only verified model with 128K context, strong reasoning, and no 404 errors—proven in our tests. The trade-off is higher compute cost, but the 0.5%+ capability jump justifies it.

name: Torque

name: Torque
text: Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct’s 128K claim isn’t free—its 405B parameter count means 3x the compute cost of Qwen2.5-72B, and our tests show latency spikes that could erase the 0.5% capability gain if EXCAVA’s pipeline chokes. Run a side-by-side 64K-token task with identical inputs on both models, measure output consistency and latency; if the 405B’s gains don’t offset its overhead, Qwen2.5-72B’s unverified but cheaper 128K claim is the safer bet.
